description: notification plugin hooks. FIVE async command hooks, all routed to hooks/notify.py. `async: true` is load-bearing, not a performance tweak: PreToolUse, Stop and TaskCompleted are blocking events where exit code 2 would suppress a question, trap Claude in a non-terminating turn, or refuse a task completion - and an async hook cannot block or control Claude at all. The script never writes to stdout, never exits non-zero, never runs a shell, and never writes state under the plugin root. Failure to notify is silent by design; run /notification:doctor to see why. Exec form (args) is used so path placeholders are passed as single arguments with no shell tokenisation.
